description: This file defines the Mimetype class within the PhpSpreadsheet library, specifically for writing ODS files. The class provides a method to output the mimetype for ODS documents.

classes.name: Mimetype
classes.description: A class responsible for writing the mimetype for OpenDocument Spreadsheet (ODS) files in the PhpSpreadsheet library.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Returns the MIME type string for an ODS spreadsheet document.
